steps.note: the box has no line round it: the Border switch reads off. The row keeps its swatch, so there is something to aim a colour at. selectedColors must read fill #B0184A and stroke #FF3B30

steps.name: offpart-1-no-line
steps.note: the box has a Border row with its switch off. An effect row keeps its swatch when it is off, so the swatch is what a colour lands on -- and letting go there has to mean what letting go on an off row means. selectedColors must read fill #B0184A and stroke #FF3B30

steps.says: Turns Border on, painted with this colour
steps.comment: An effect that is switched OFF keeps its swatch, so the colour lands on the swatch rather than on the row. It promises both halves of what letting go does, exactly as the Fill row lower down does: the Border comes back ON wearing the colour. A colour you drop always shows up.

steps.note: letting go switched the Border back on wearing the colour: stroke must read #B0184A and the Border switch must now read on. A colour dropped on something switched off turns it on as well as painting it.
ONE undo took back BOTH halves: stroke is #FF3B30 again and the Border switch reads off again
a shadow added and then switched off. It keeps its five settings and its colour, so its swatch is what a colour lands on -- and letting go there brings the shadow back

steps.says: Turns Shadow on, painted with this colour

steps.note: the same gesture works on any effect that is switched off: the shadow is back on, wearing the fill colour

the fill switched off. An Appearance part that is off shows NO swatch at all, so the row itself is the only thing left to let a colour go on: this is the 2026-09-07 complaint's own shape, and the sentence has to promise both halves of what letting go does.

steps.says: Turns Fill on, painted with this colour
steps.comment: Letting go here does two things and the line beside the row promises both: it turns the part on AND paints it.

steps.note: letting go both gave the box its fill back and painted it in the border's colour
ONE undo took the whole thing back: the fill is off again, switch and colour together
